notes: Identical synthetic fixtures; isolated temporary SQLite databases; human approval excluded.
All attempts are included in latency distributions. Provider failures count as failures, not correct escalations.
Single-machine serial trials; concurrent booking checks are separate deterministic stress tests.
29 of 30 LLM investigations failed; short failure latencies are not recovery times.
The 16.75-second and 51.281-second historical observations are excluded from these distributions.
Accepted tool-call counts were normalized from recorded source-tagged tool events to avoid counting internal escalation twice. Original counters remain in original_tool_calls.

stress_checks.evidence: Clock advanced 121 seconds; hold expired and capacity was reusable
Stale approval blocked; insufficient capacity escalated
Declined D3; proposed D2 with fresh approval required

sampling: Serial burst, no deliberate inter-trial pacing or automatic provider retries.
failure_diagnostics: Original run stored failed=True but not structured per-run causes. A separate follow-up No capacity diagnostic returned HTTP 429 after rejected model tool calls. This does not establish the cause of every failed trial.
